prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Animate the person in [Image 1] through various high-stakes scenes while they talk with sophisticated confidence in formal attire: a fast, stylish 1960s London gangster film montage, cut on the beat of a slow, heavy song. Warm amber and bottle-green film colors, soft 35mm grain, shallow focus, slow-motion moments. The star is the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. The same real person in every shot, never morph, never another face. Only the star has this face; everyone else has their own different face. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the star is that animal standing or sitting upright in a small dark suit, with its own face, fur and markings, not a person. The star wears a sharp dark tailored 1960s suit, a crisp white shirt and a slim dark tie, hair neatly combed, and moves with a calm, cocky swagger.

Shot 1 [0-1.2s]: close-up in a dim old London pub, bottles glowing on the shelves behind: the star lifts the chin and looks down into the camera with a slow, cocky half-smile.
Shot 2 [1.2-2.3s]: hard cut, medium close-up at a green card table in a private gaming club: the star stacks a few chips with one ringed hand and glances up with a sly look.
Shot 3 [2.3-3.4s]: hard cut, the back seat of a dark vintage car at night, street lights sliding over the face: the star rests the chin on one hand and stares into the lens.
Shot 4 [3.4-4.6s]: hard cut, full body on a sunny brick street of terraced houses: the star leans back against a dark green 1960s saloon car, hands in the pockets, a slow grin.
Shot 5 [4.6-5.8s]: hard cut, low angle, slow motion: the star walks straight toward the camera down the street, jacket open, the vintage car behind.
Shot 6 [5.8-7s]: hard cut, close-up: the star tilts the head, raises the eyebrows and mouths a few cheeky words to the camera with a wide grin.
Shot 7 [7-8.5s]: hard cut, slow motion: the star, now in a black dinner jacket and a black bow tie, walks into a crowded 1960s nightclub with warm lights and a band, and the guests turn to watch.
Shot 8 [8.5-10s]: hard cut, final close-up: the star straightens the tie, turns a ring on one finger and looks into the camera with a calm, dangerous smile to the last frame, the face large and sharp.

No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
No cigarettes, no cigars, no pipes, no smoke from the mouth. No guns, no weapons, no violence, no blood. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no car badges, no watermark.

prompts.text: A stylish 1960s London gangster film moment, warm amber colors, soft film grain, slow and confident. Keep the pet exactly as in the image: the same face, eyes, ears, fur and markings, and the small dark suit and tie, with the natural body of that animal. Shot 3, cut to a wider shot in slow motion: it hops down from the stool and struts toward the camera through the pub, the men in suits turning to watch, and stops with a calm stare into the lens to the last frame.
